text:
Synthetic case mein pichhle saat complete din ka median do outgoing calls per day hai. Event day par replay time tak gyarah calls hain. Configured threshold max of five calls aur three times baseline hai, yani six. Isliye communication signal trigger hota hai. Teen connected transfers pachhattar minutes mein total ek lakh panchanve hazaar ka volume dikhate hain. Yeh unique funds ya money laundering ka proof nahi. Graph context aur exact source evidence ke saath system review lead banata hai.

text:
Frontend React, TypeScript aur Cytoscape par hai. FastAPI typed requests serve karta hai. Structured identifiers deterministic parsers se aate hain. spaCy NER optional local model ke available hone par use hota hai, fallback bhi hai. NetworkX bounded shortest paths compute karta hai. Temporal rules main lead engine hain. Isolation Forest secondary anomaly triage hai. Local SQLite investigator decisions rakhta hai. Hum LLM, GNN ya universal Hindi OCR implemented hone ka claim nahi karte.
